book.name: MADIU
book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn MADIU

content: Ihs me Keieu Lapalap nan Wehin Koht?
Ni ahnsowohte tohnpadahk ko keiong mpen Sises oh kalelapak reh, “Ihs me keieu lapalap nan Wehin Koht?”
Sises eri malipedohng reh kisin seri kis, ketikihdiong nanpwungarail
oh mahsanih, “Kumwail en ese pwe ma kumwail sohte wekila oh rasehngala kisin seri kan, kumwail sohte pahn pedolong nan Wehin Koht.
Pwe me kin aktikitik oh rasehngala kisin seri menet, ih me keieu lapalap nan Wehin Koht.
Oh me kin kasamwo kisin seri duwehte met ni mwarei, e kin kasamwo ie.”
Kahrehiong Nan Dihp
“Mehmen me pahn kahrehiong en emen me tikitik pwukat me pwoson ie eh pahn dipada, e pahn mwahwong ma lapalahn peitehl ehu pahn pirapiriong nin tepinwere e ahpw kekihrlahng nan kepin madau.
Meid suwediong sampah mehn kau pwukat en kin pwarada! Eri soh, soahng pwukat pahn kin mie ahnsou koaros - ahpw meid suwediong aramaso me mehn kau pwukat tepisang reh!

“Ma apali pehmw oh apali nehmwen kahrehiong uhk nan dihp, lupukasang oh kesehweisang uhk, pwe e mwahwong uhk pedolong nan mour soutuk peh pali oh neh pali sang peh oh neh pokon lekdeklahng nan kisiniei soutuk.
Oh ma apali mesomwen me kin kahrehiong uhk nan dihp, pwadikasang oh kesehweisang uhk, pwe e mwahwong uhk pedolong nan mour soutuk mas pali sang mas pokon lekdeklahng nan kisinieien nan ehl.”
Karasaras en Sihpw me Salongalahr
“Kumwail kaleke pwe kumwail dehr mwamwahlki emen me tikitik pwukat. Kumwail en ese pwe arail tohnleng kin aririh Semei me ketiket nanleng ahnsou koaros.
[Pwe Nein-Aramas ketidohng kamourala me salongalahr akan]

“Dahme kumwail lemeleme? Ma aramas emen naineki sihpw epwiki, emen irail ahpw salongala, e seu pahn mweidala mahs me duwehk duwemeno re en mwengemwengeseli pohn nahna, a e ahpw pahn kohwei raparapahkiseli me salongalahro?
A ma e pahn diarada, kumwail en ese pwe eh perenki memeno inenen laudsang eh perenki me duwehk duwemeno me sohte salongala.
Ih pil duwen Samamwail me ketiket nanleng, e sohte kin ketin kupwurki emen me tikitik pwukat en kin salongala.”
Mahkohng Riomw me kin Wia Suwediong Uhk
“Ma riomw wiahda dihpiong uhk, kohwei reh oh kapwungohng dipeo. Ahpw met en wiawi nanpwungamwahte. Ma e pahn rong uhk, eri a, ke kasapahldohr riomwo.
A ma e sohte pahn rong uhk, a emen de riemen en ianguhkada, pwe me riemeno de silimeno en wia kadehdehn soahng koaros nin duwen me Pwuhk Sarawi mahsanih.
A ma e pil sohte men rong irail, a ke lelki mwomwohdiso. A ma e pil sohte men rong mwomwohdiso, a wiahkihla ih mehn liki men de sounrik daksis men.”
Manaman en Salihedi oh Lapwahda
“I men kumwail koaros en ese pwe mehkoaros me kumwail pahn keinapwihdi nin sampah, e pahn pil keinapwihdi nanleng; oh mehkoaros me kumwail pahn mweidada nin sampah, e pahn pil mweimweida nanleng.
“A pil ehu, ma riemen rehmwail pahn miniminkipene ara kapakap nin sampah oh peki mehkot, e uhdahn pahn pweiong ira sang rehn Semei me ketiket nanleng.
Pwe wasa kis me riemen de silimen kin kohpene ie ni mwarei, I kin iang irail mi wasao.”
Karasepen Ladu Sempoak
Piter eri keiong mpen Sises oh patohwanohng, “Maing ei Kaun, pak depe I pahn mahkohng rieio me kin wia dihpiong ie? E itar ma I pahn mahkohng pak isuh?”
Sises ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Soh, e sohte itar pahn pak isipak, ahpw pahn pak isuh wad isihsek.
Pwe Wehin Koht kin rasehng nanmwarki men me kupwuredahr en wia kopwungpen pweipwand en sapellime papah kan.
Ni eh ketin tapihada kopwungo, iet emen me wisikdohng reh, me pweipwandkihong toala million kei.

A ni eh sohte nah mwohni me itar mehn pwainla pweipwando, mwohnsapwo mahsanih pwe en netila duwehte ladu men, iangahki eh pwoud, nah seri kan oh mehkoaros me e ahneki, pwe en kapwungkihla eh pweipwando.
Papaho ahpw kelehpwikihdi mwowe, patohwanohng, ‘Maing, komw kupwurmahk, ketin kanengamahiong ie, pwe I pahn pwainohng komwi mehkoaros!’
Mwohnsapwo ahpw kupwurehla oh mahkikihong eh pweipwand oh mweidohng en kohkohla.
“E kohieisangete wasao, kasaingedi kiseh papah men me pweipwandkihong ih toalahte depe. E ahpw poarohng, padikpene tepinwere, ndahng, “Mwadang kapwungodo omw pweipwand ong ie!’
Papaho ahpw poaridi mwowe, ndahng, ‘Kanengamahiong ie mahs, I pahn pwainohng uhk!’
A e kahng rong, pwe e uhdahte kesehlong nan imweteng, e lao pahn kak kapwungala eh pweipwand.
Ni kiseh papah ko ar kilangehr me wiawihero, re ahpw nsensuwedkihla kowahlap oh kohla kairehki ar mwohnsapwo mehkoaros.
Mwohnsapwo ahpw malipehdo sapwellime papaho oh mahsanihong, ‘Papah suwed men kowe! I mahkikihong uhk omw pweipwand ong ie koaros pwehki omw peki mahk rehi;
a dahme ke sohte mahkikihong iengomw papaho, duwehte ei mahkohng uhk?’
Mwohnsapwo eri angiangihada kowahlap oh ketikihlong nan imweteng pwe en lokolok e lao pahn kapwungala eh pweipwand koaros.
Sises eri mahsanih, “Ih duwen me Semei me ketiket nanleng pahn ketin wiahiong kumwail, ma emenemen kumwail sohte pahn mahkohng rie sang nan kapehde.”
